Quran, hadith ne adhkar nkyerɛwee ahorow no kɔ nyamesom mu nhwehwɛmu titiriw mu, a ɛyɛ soronko wɔ mmara nhwehwɛmu ho, ansa na wɔayi no adi wɔ aban kwan so. Kuran nkyerɛwee fibea: Tanzil adwuma (Uthmani nkyerɛwee).
Muslim yɛ app a wontua hwee koraa, a wɔabue ano wɔ GPLv3 tumi krataa ase — dawurubɔ biara nni hɔ, nkrataahyɛ biara nni hɔ, akyidi biara nni hɔ. Version biara a wɔasesa no tra hɔ a ɛyɛ open source.
Free forever · Privacy first · Nsoromma mu hwɛ mu pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ wɔ mpaebɔ bere ne qibla mu · Ɛyɛ adwuma offline · Mmoa ma mmara sukuu ahorow denam nhyehyɛe a wotumi sesa so.

Muslim bu wo kokoam nsɛm na ɔnnye wo data ano.

• Tracking biara nni hɔ: ad SDKs, analytics anaa marketing trackers biara nni hɔ.
• Data tra wo device so: wɔde wo data nyinaa (beae, nhyehyɛe, bookmarks) sie wo mpɔtam hɔ wɔ wo device nkutoo so.
• Beae a wɔde di dwuma wɔ mpɔtam hɔ: wɔde wo coordinates di dwuma de bu mpaebɔ ho akontaa mmere ne qibla a ɛwɔ wo mfiri no so, na wɔmfa nkɔ abɔnten so server biara so da.
• Tumi krataa bere a ɛho hia nkutoo: yɛsrɛ tumi krataa (beae, amanneɛbɔ) bere a ade bi hia ankasa nkutoo, a nkyerɛkyerɛmu a emu da hɔ ka ho.
• Nkitahodi a wɔhyɛ biara nni hɔ: app no yɛ adwuma wɔ intanɛt so; netwɛk dwumadie yɛ nea wɔpaw koraa ma nneɛma foforo te sɛ akenkan a wɔtwe.

Saa nhyehyɛe yi yɛ adekorabea a wɔabue ano no fã na wɔabue ama mpɔtam hɔfo ahwɛ mu.

Ɔhokafoɔ a ɔdi mu, ɔde ne ho, ɔbue ano ma Muslimi biara — mpaebɔ mmerɛ, Adhan, Quran, hadith, adhkar ne nea ɛkeka ho, wɔ wo kasa mu.

Muslim yɛ Android app a wontua hwee na ɛbue a ɛka wo ho da mũ no nyinaa: mpaebɔ bere a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ nsoromma mu hwɛ mu ne Adhan, Qibla kɔmpase a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, Kur’aan a edi mũ a akenkan ne tafsir wom, hadith nhomakorabea, adhkar a wonya fi mu, ɛlɛtrɔnik tasbih, Ramadan nnwinnade, zakat akontaabu, asase mfonini a ɛwɔ intanɛt so, ne nea ɛkeka ho — wɔayɛ sɛ ɛbɛyɛ adwuma koraa a ɛnyɛ nea ɛwɔ intanɛt so a kokoamsɛm ka ho denam default.
Biribiara a Nkramofo hia wɔ app biako mu:
Mpaebɔ mmere & Adhan — akontaabu akwan nyinaa, mmara sukuu ahorow, ne 18+ adhan nnyigyei
Kuran a edi mũ — Uthmani nkyerɛwee, akenkanfo 44, tafsir, nkyerɛase, nsɛmfua hwehwɛ & mpɛn dodow
Adhkar, tasbih, Ramadan & Zakat — a nkaebɔ ne ahurututu a ɛsensɛn nsuo mu
Offline-first — maps, Quran, hadith ne adhkar yɛ adwuma a intanɛt nni hɔ
Privacy by default — dawurubɔ biara nni hɔ, tracking biara nni hɔ, wo data tra wo device so
